name: Indian Army Agniveer (Agnipath scheme)
department: Indian Army (Agnipath scheme, Ministry of Defence)
summary: Four-year enrolment in the Army as an Agniveer (General Duty, Technical, Clerk, Tradesman). Monthly package from Rs 30,000 to Rs 40,000, about Rs 11.71 lakh Seva Nidhi at exit, and up to 25% of each batch kept as regular soldiers.

status.note: Yearly cycle: notification around February, online Common Entrance Exam around June, then recruitment rallies. In 2026 the notification came on 12 February, the CEE ran from 1 to 16 June and the result came on 12 July 2026.

posts.name: Agniveer (GD, Technical, Clerk / Store Keeper, Tradesman)
posts.responsibilities: Soldier duties in the chosen category for four years.
posts.notes: GD needs Class 10; Technical and Clerk need Class 12 with subject conditions.

age.summary: 17.5 to 21 years (the 2026-27 cycle used birth dates between 1 July 2005 and 1 July 2009).

eligibility.nationality: Citizen of India (and other categories as per notice).

education.summary: General Duty: Class 10. Technical, Clerk and other categories: Class 12 or Class 10 with the subject and marks conditions in the notice.

eligibility.physical: Physical fitness test and physical measurement standards by region, then a medical exam.
eligibility.reservation: Central reservation: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC (non-creamy layer) 27%, EWS 10%, plus horizontal reservation for PwBD and ex-servicemen as per rules.

stages.name: Recruitment rally: physical fitness and measurement tests

selection.meritCalculation: Merit from the CEE and rally performance, region-wise.
selection.languages: English and Hindi plus regional languages.

salary.officialGrossNote: First-year package Rs 30,000 a month: Rs 21,000 in hand and Rs 9,000 to the Agniveer Corpus Fund, matched by the government.
salary.pension: No pension or gratuity. Seva Nidhi of about Rs 11.71 lakh (tax free) on exit after four years.
salary.notes: Non-contributory life insurance of Rs 48 lakh during service.

progression.post: Regular soldier (up to 25% of each batch)

career.promotionNotes: Selection to the regular cadre is based on performance during the four years.

benefits.detail: Rs 48 lakh life insurance during service; about Rs 11.71 lakh Seva Nidhi at exit.

workLife.postings: Army units across India, including field areas.
workLife.stability: Fixed four-year term; regular cadre only for up to 25%.

difficulty.rationale: Basic written test, but tough physical standards and many applicants.

ratings.rationale: Yearly intake, but only four years unless retained.
